Definition: Integration of company registration, business licensing, tax compliance, regulatory compliance data
Comments: No evidence of business registration integration into a data exchange platform.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original 0/Unknown score rested on a 2022 pre-war World Bank diagnostic that predates Sudan's current e-government build-out. Sudan's Baldna platform (rolled out from December 2025, 28 services added February 2026) provides direct company registration, business-name registration and business licensing services integrating the Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Local Governance, Ministry of Industry and Trade (26 listed services) and the Commercial Registrar. The December 2025 exports/imports window on Baldna further links company registration with the Central Bank, Customs, tax and standards bodies. This is confirmed, specific evidence of partial integration, not the absence previously recorded.
revised_comments: Business registration and licensing functions are partially integrated into Sudan's national data exchange via the Baldna e-government platform, which provides company registration, business-name registration and licensing services linking the Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Local Governance, Ministry of Industry and Trade and the Commercial Registrar, with further linkage to customs and banking systems through the platform's exports/imports window.

Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: No evidence of CRVS integration into a data exchange system. Conflict has severely disrupted civil registration.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original score of 0/Unknown was based on a 2022 pre-war World Bank diagnostic and did not reflect subsequent developments. In October 2025 Sudan's Customs Authority completed digital integration of the ASYCUDA customs system with the Civil Registry database via the Baldna platform, explicitly to verify national ID numbers and prevent fraud. The Civil Registry is also named as one of the systems integrated into Baldna's exports/imports window alongside the Central Bank, Customs, Ministry of Trade, commercial banks, and tax and standards bodies. This is confirmed, specific evidence of partial CRVS integration into the national data exchange, notwithstanding the severe disruption civil registration services face amid the conflict.
revised_comments: Civil registration data is partially integrated into Sudan's data exchange: the Civil Registry database has been digitally linked with the ASYCUDA customs system and the Baldna e-government platform's exports/imports window (Central Bank, Customs, Ministry of Trade, tax and standards bodies) since October 2025, primarily for identity verification purposes, notwithstanding ongoing disruption to civil registration services caused by the conflict.

revision_notes: Original 0/Unknown score rested on a 2022 pre-war World Bank diagnostic. Comments: No evidence of employment services integration into a data exchange platform.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original 0/Unknown score rested on a 2022 pre-war World Bank diagnostic. Sudan's Ministry of Cabinet Affairs, the Civil Service Selection Commission and the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications are in final preparations to launch a unified government employment platform for jobseekers (domestic and diaspora) applying to state institutions, per official government (sudan.gov.sd) reporting. Definition: Integration of driver's license registration and traffic offence data
Comments: No evidence of driver licensing integration into a data exchange platform.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original 0/Unknown score rested on a 2022 pre-war World Bank diagnostic. Sudan's traffic police operate the 'Salem' electronic platform enabling driving-licence renewal using the national ID number as login credential, and Baldna's public service catalogue lists driving-licence and vehicle-registration renewal as an available digital service. A June 2026 report describes a further, larger digital-transformation project under way within the traffic police to expand smart services. This is confirmed evidence of under-development integration (renewal transactions live, broader traffic-offence data integration not yet confirmed), an upgrade from 'no evidence' but short of full/partial integration across all licensing and offence data.
revised_comments: Driver's licence renewal is available electronically via the traffic police 'Salem' platform and the Baldna e-government portal, authenticated against the national ID number, while a broader digital-transformation project to modernise traffic and licensing systems more fully is under way.

Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: No evidence of tax/revenue system integration into a data exchange platform. Conflict has disrupted existing revenue systems.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original 0/Unknown score rested on a 2022 pre-war World Bank diagnostic. The Sudan Taxation Chamber's core tax system and e-invoicing infrastructure has identified 18 external entities for integration (prioritising Customs, Civil Registry, Commercial Registrar, Accounting Bureau, Central Bank of Sudan and Ministry of Trade), reported as over 80% implemented as of 2025. A February 2025 announcement confirms completed network integration between the Customs Authority and the Tax Authority. This is confirmed, specific evidence of substantial (though not complete) integration, an upgrade from the previous 'no evidence' finding.
revised_comments: Tax and revenue systems are substantially integrated into Sudan's data exchange: the Sudan Taxation Chamber's core system and e-invoicing platform have been linked with the Customs Authority, Civil Registry, Commercial Registrar, Central Bank of Sudan and Ministry of Trade, with the wider integration programme reported as more than 80% complete as of 2025.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: No public implementation roadmap for data exchange/interoperability found. Conflict since 2023 has disrupted any planning efforts.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original score of 1/No was based on a 2022 pre-war World Bank diagnostic and a 2025 VoxDev piece, both predating the government's published transformation plan. The Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications has since publicised a phased '3x3 Digital Transformation Plan' (three pathways: citizen services, private-sector services, government-sector services, each mapped to specific named projects and lead ministries), with Phase One completed and Phase Two launched by early 2026. This is a public, named, phased roadmap, meeting the criteria for 'Yes.'
revised_comments: Sudan has a public implementation roadmap for data exchange and digital transformation: the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications' '3x3 Digital Transformation Plan' sets out three phased pathways (citizen services, private-sector services and government-sector services), each with named projects and lead ministries, with its first phase completed and second phase launched by early 2026.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Is artificial intelligence integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics
Comments: A Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority was decreed in Nov 2025 but is newly established. Ongoing conflict has rendered existing digital infrastructure largely non-functional.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original score of 0/Unknown is largely confirmed but refined: no evidence of AI functionally integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics. However, the Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority, established by prime-ministerial decree on 5 November 2025 under the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications, gives Sudan an institutional mandate specifically for data/AI governance, which was absent from the previous 'Unknown' assessment. As the authority is newly created and not yet reported to be piloting any AI use case, score is raised from 0/Unknown to 2/Planned rather than higher.
revised_comments: AI is not yet integrated into Sudan's data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics, but a Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority was established by prime-ministerial decree in November 2025 under the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications, giving the country an institutional mandate to plan such capabilities.
